children: Passage Bio amended its merger agreement with Remix Therapeutics to implement a two-step structure intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization while preserving prior economics, closing conditions, and the Dec. 24, 2026 outside date. In tandem, Remix and investors amended the concurrent private placement to allow purchases of common shares at $1.3861 or pre-funded warrants at $1.3860, totaling about $70.0 million; these pre-funded warrants will convert into Passage Bio warrants at closing. Passage Bio also revised the form of its Registration Rights Agreement to register both financing shares and shares issuable upon exercise of the pre-funded warrants, with a resale filing due within 30 days after the second merger. The updates are designed to streamline closing mechanics and support investor liquidity post-merger.
